sloka: तौ उवाच महाबाहुः कबन्धो दानव उत्तमः ।कौ युवाम् वृषभ स्कन्धौ महा खड्ग धनुर् धरौ ॥३-६९-४३॥
transliteration: tau uvāca mahābāhuḥ kabandho dānava uttamaḥ ।kau yuvām vṛṣabha skandhau mahā khaḍga dhanur dharau ॥3-69-43॥

translations.english: Who are you with bulllike shoulders, wielding big swords, bows and arrows? By coming to this place you have become my food.
